name: Spark Connect
summary: See your home servers on one screen and fix them over SSH: services, health, tunnel, failover and websites.
summary_fr: Voir vos serveurs sur un seul écran et les réparer par SSH : services, état, tunnel, bascule et sites web.

optional.spark-terminal: Open terminal and Failback (another terminal program works too)
optional.sdl-freerdp: Take control of a SparkOS desktop (xfreerdp works too; mstsc on Windows)
optional.notify-send: desktop notifications when a machine or site goes wrong

needs.system: Linux or Windows 10/11 (OpenSSH client); the servers need only sh, systemd and the usual tools of a stock Ubuntu or Fedora server
